svg.title: OL-CATHEDRAL cohort plates: Tudor-inventory line-engraving
svg.desc: Three engraved inventory plates for An Open Letter chs. VIII-X: an eagle-warrant reset diptych; the flagship Gothic westwork mid-dissolution with Fundamentalens and ledger strip; the Receiver's double-entry ledger with ELBO certificate. No letterforms baked in; all inscriptions are HTML overlays.
